name: pickup_find_spawn_by_pickup_id
description: Pickup::FindSpawnByPickupId walks a pickup spawn list and returns the first spawn whose pickupId matches the requested id.
known_limits: The shared pickup leaf-helper smoke also covers adjacent pickup leaf functions. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Pickup runtime pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41e930 validates loading list->head, walking next pointers, comparing each spawn pickupId with the requested id, returning the matching node, and returning null after exhausting the list.
The native pickup leaf-helper smoke verifies matching the first node, matching a later node, and returning null for a missing pickup id.
